title: Amplified Dimension (Flooded)
description: Amplified Dimension but the water level is really high.
body:
Basics

Adds a dimension that mirrors the overworld, but it uses the amplified terrain generator, except the water level is way higher! This dimension is as close as can be to the overworld in terms of biome placement, structure placement, and feature placement. 

Terrablender biomes seem to work in the amplified dimension.

Important Notes
This datapack/mod does not provide a way to enter the dimension! I recommend using the Datapack Portals Mod to make a datapack that allows you to construct a portal that leads to the dimension. The Dimension's namespace is "amplidimflooded:overworld" in case you want to use the execute command to teleport into it.

It does rain in the dimension, but for the /weather command to work, you have to execute it in the default overworld. The weather is synced between both dimensions, as well as time.

Other Recommendations
Any datapack that makes the overworld taller. It will apply to the amplified dimension too and allow you to build on the taller mountains, which stretch very close to build limit!
Also goes with my other datapack: Amplified Dimension! (Its just like this but without the extreme water level)

Tested on 1.20.1 but also might work on other versions.

Usage In Modpacks
You're more than welcome to put this in a modpack, just credit me if the modpack is public!

Note to Modpack Authors: since this dimension isn't exactly the overworld, some mods might need extra configuring to recognize it as a valid overworld dimension for some of their features!
